definitions.explanation: To place something into an opening or container.
To insert a cutting into soil or another plant.

examples.japanese: {花|はな}を{花瓶|かびん}に挿す。
examples.english: To put flowers in a vase.

notes:
KANJI DISTINCTION:
- {挿|さ}す: to insert
- {刺|さ}す: to stab, pierce
- {指|さ}す: to point
- {差|さ}す: to hold up (umbrella)
- {射|さ}す: to shine (light)
